urdu: ونڈسر انٹاریو میں مارچ 2023 میں منعقد ہونے والے مشاعرے کے منتظم کون تھے؟
english: Who organized the poetry event in Windsor, Ontario in March 2023?
roman_1: Windsor Ontario mein March 2023 mein mun'aqid hone wale mushaira ke munazzim kaun thay?
roman_2: Windsor Ontario mein March 2023 main mun'aqid hone walay mushaira ke munazzim kon they?
roman_3: Windsor Ontario mein March 2023 may mun'aqid hone walay mushaira ke munazzim kon the?
